scope_note: These paths define practice outputs and completion evidence. They do not predict interview outcomes or replace role-specific recruiter guidance.

paths.title: 7-day interview sprint
paths.audience: A candidate with an interview within one week who needs a defensible core story and one scored rehearsal.
entry_evidence: One target role or role family
One project the learner can discuss without confidentiality violations

sessions.title: Choose the two largest interview risks
sessions.goal: Stop broad rereading and define a narrow practice backlog.
sessions.output: A one-page baseline naming the target role, two highest-risk dimensions, and evidence currently available.
completion_checks: Each risk cites an observable behavior rather than a technology label.
The learner removes at least one low-priority topic from the week.

sessions.title: Build the strongest project spine
sessions.goal: Turn one project into a FIELD narrative with personal decisions and boundaries.
sessions.output: A two-minute project narrative plus a fact, decision, artifact, result, and limit table.
completion_checks: Team outcomes and personal contribution are stated separately.
At least one trade-off and one unresolved limitation are explicit.

sessions.title: Practice customer discovery
sessions.goal: Frame workflow, baseline, risk, and non-goals before proposing architecture.
sessions.output: A recorded 15-minute discovery conversation and a written problem frame.
completion_checks: The frame names a user action and current baseline.
The recording includes a non-goal and a decision-changing unknown.

sessions.title: Design from the workflow
sessions.goal: Connect data, control, evidence, and operating paths to a thin release.
sessions.output: One architecture page with a staged release, failure paths, and rollback conditions.
completion_checks: The design shows data, control, and evidence flows.
At least one simpler alternative and one stop condition are defended.

sessions.title: Defend production AI boundaries
sessions.goal: Explain evaluation, tool safety, observability, and human intervention without hiding behind frameworks.
sessions.output: A release contract covering evaluation slices, authority, monitoring, rollback, and human escalation.
completion_checks: Quality and safety gates are separated.
The learner can name a condition where an agent should not be used.

sessions.title: Run one blind mock
sessions.goal: Produce evidence under time pressure without reading interviewer material.
sessions.output: A recording, an independent score sheet, and the two lowest behavior anchors.
completion_checks: Scoring cites exact statements or artifacts from the session.
The debrief selects only two behaviors for repair.

sessions.title: Repair and rehearse the final version
sessions.goal: Replace weak behaviors and leave a compact interview-day pack.
sessions.output: A second recording, score comparison, one-page interview map, and explicit claims boundary.
completion_checks: The second attempt changes the two selected behaviors, not only wording.
Every portfolio claim is labeled direct, adjacent, exercise, or gap.

exit_evidence: One scored blind mock and one targeted re-recording
One project spine, one system-design page, and one release contract
limits: Seven days is a risk-reduction sprint, not complete FDE preparation.
A self-score is weaker than an independent score and must be labeled as such.
No exercise may be presented as production experience.

paths.title: 14-day role-targeting campaign
paths.audience: A candidate with a specific public job description who needs to align evidence and practice without guessing the employer's private process.
entry_evidence: A public job description captured with date and URL
A resume or project inventory that can be truthfully decomposed

sessions.title: Separate public facts from interview hypotheses
sessions.goal: Create a bounded role brief before choosing practice topics.
sessions.output: A dated role brief with public facts, hypotheses, confirmation questions, and exclusions.
completion_checks: No inferred interview round is written as a fact.
Every volatile requirement records its source and capture date.

sessions.title: Grade the evidence honestly
sessions.goal: Classify direct, adjacent, exercise, and gap evidence for the role.
sessions.output: A D/A/E/G evidence matrix with one accepted artifact and one boundary per claim.
completion_checks: Direct evidence names personal ownership and an inspectable artifact.
Gaps remain visible instead of being rewritten as adjacent evidence.

sessions.title: Choose a role playbook
sessions.goal: Select one primary role path and state why the other paths are secondary.
sessions.output: A role selection memo with one primary path, one adjacent path, and two non-priorities.
completion_checks: Selection is based on role signals and evidence, not title alone.
The learner records what information could change the selection.

sessions.title: Build a 90-second position
sessions.goal: Connect engineering spine, customer outcome, and product leverage.
sessions.output: Two recorded 90-second introductions and a transcript with unsupported phrases removed.
completion_checks: The introduction contains one concrete decision and outcome.
It avoids generic claims such as strong communication without evidence.

sessions.title: Deep-dive the strongest matching project
sessions.goal: Prepare follow-up depth beyond the opening narrative.
sessions.output: A project evidence tree covering decisions, artifacts, alternatives, failure, operation, and reuse.
completion_checks: Every claimed result has a measurement or an explicit evidence limit.
At least three likely follow-ups can be answered without inventing detail.

sessions.title: Complete the role-specific technical exercise
sessions.goal: Produce a runnable or reviewable artifact for the largest technical gap.
sessions.output: One role-specific implementation, design, or threat model with tests or review criteria.
completion_checks: The artifact exposes failure and operating boundaries.
The learner labels it as production, adjacent, or exercise evidence.

sessions.title: Practice a customer pressure scenario
sessions.goal: Make progress without overpromising unsafe scope.
sessions.output: A recorded refusal-and-alternative conversation with a concrete next experiment.
completion_checks: The response names the risk instead of hiding behind policy language.
The alternative preserves customer progress and defines a decision date.

sessions.title: Run the role-targeted blind loop
sessions.goal: Test the campaign under a consistent 75-minute protocol.
sessions.output: A recording, independent score, evidence citations, and two veto-risk behaviors.
completion_checks: Candidate material remained separate from interviewer evidence.
The score sheet records observable evidence and confidence.

sessions.title: Repair the two veto risks
sessions.goal: Change decision behavior rather than polishing general fluency.
sessions.output: Two short re-runs and a before-and-after evidence comparison.
completion_checks: Each repair has a trigger, replacement behavior, and observable proof.
Unchanged or worse scores remain visible.

sessions.title: Assemble the interview campaign pack
sessions.goal: Leave a compact, truthful operating pack for the actual interview.
sessions.output: A final role brief, evidence matrix, project routes, questions, risk list, and next-practice decision.
completion_checks: The pack fits the target role without pretending to know private rounds.
Every gap has a mitigation, confirmation question, or explicit acceptance.

exit_evidence: A source-bounded role brief and D/A/E/G matrix
One role artifact, one blind score, and one documented repair cycle
limits: The campaign prepares for observable capability, not leaked company questions.
Public job descriptions may be incomplete or stale and require confirmation.
Role fit cannot be reduced to a mechanical percentage.

paths.title: 30-day field-ready foundation
paths.title_zh: 三十天现场交付基础训练
paths.audience: A learner who wants interview readiness and a reusable field-delivery operating system rather than a short cram plan.
entry_evidence: At least five hours per week for deliberate practice
Permission to create synthetic or public portfolio artifacts without exposing confidential work

sessions.title: Baseline the FIELD operating model
sessions.goal: Diagnose current strength across framing, inspection, engineering, launch, and distillation.
sessions.output: A baseline score with evidence confidence and a thirty-day risk backlog.
completion_checks: Scores cite existing evidence or explicitly say none.
The backlog prioritizes no more than three dimensions.

sessions.title: Map one customer workflow
sessions.goal: Understand actors, handoffs, decisions, and current failure cost.
sessions.output: A workflow map, stakeholder map, baseline, and discovery decision log.
completion_checks: The map includes human workarounds and ownership.
At least one assumption is converted into a verification action.

sessions.title: Ship a thin technical slice
sessions.goal: Demonstrate coding, data, interface, and failure-handling fundamentals.
sessions.output: A runnable thin slice with tests, interface contract, failure cases, and a short decision record.
completion_checks: Another person can run the artifact from documented steps.
At least one failure path and one recovery path are tested.

sessions.title: Build the production AI evidence loop
sessions.goal: Version inputs and evaluate system behavior by risk slice.
sessions.output: A version matrix, sliced evaluation set, release gates, observability plan, and rollback rule.
completion_checks: Aggregate quality cannot hide the highest-risk slice.
A regression can be replayed with fixed dependencies.

sessions.title: Control tool authority and long-running state
sessions.goal: Design identity, authorization, idempotency, progress, cancellation, and recovery.
sessions.output: A tool execution state machine and a durable task recovery contract.
completion_checks: Client disconnect is separated from job cancellation.
Irreversible actions have authorization, idempotency, and audit boundaries.

sessions.title: Run a data lifecycle review
sessions.goal: Define identity, upsert, deletion, permission, replay, and reconciliation semantics.
sessions.output: A data lifecycle contract and reconciliation design with failure examples.
completion_checks: Content deletion and permission revocation have distinct timing rules.
An incomplete snapshot cannot silently become a mass delete.

sessions.title: Threat-model a regulated workflow
sessions.goal: Connect trust boundaries, human responsibility, evidence, and staged authority.
sessions.output: A threat model, responsibility matrix, evidence-retention boundary, and staged authority plan.
completion_checks: Human review specifies timing, information, authority, and escalation.
Prompt-only controls are not used for identity or authorization.

sessions.title: Lead a production incident
sessions.goal: Protect users, preserve evidence, localize cause, and prevent recurrence.
sessions.output: An incident timeline, containment decision, TRACE diagnosis, recovery proof, and prevention backlog.
completion_checks: Containment is separated from root-cause claims.
Recovery is proven with user and system evidence.

sessions.title: Design adoption and handoff
sessions.goal: Move from technical correctness to trusted operation by the customer team.
sessions.output: An adoption ladder, operating handoff, recovery rehearsal, and ownership matrix.
completion_checks: Adoption is measured by user action, not training attendance.
The operating team can detect and recover one failure without the builder.

sessions.title: Distill field learning into product leverage
sessions.goal: Decide what belongs in product, extension, template, or retained customization.
sessions.output: A field-to-product memo with repeated signal, abstraction boundary, owner, non-goals, and second-use test.
completion_checks: Reuse is defined by a second context, not copied code.
Maintenance ownership and migration cost are explicit.

sessions.title: Run two blind cases
sessions.goal: Observe decision quality across a planned case and an incident case.
sessions.output: Two recordings, two independent score sheets, and a cross-case behavior comparison.
completion_checks: The facilitator releases evidence only after valid questions or scheduled injection.
Cross-case comparison uses behavior anchors rather than total score alone.

sessions.title: Publish the truthful evidence portfolio
sessions.goal: Assemble a reviewable body of work and a next-cycle plan.
sessions.output: A portfolio index, claim-to-artifact map, final mock, retrospective, and next thirty-day plan.
completion_checks: Every claim points to an inspectable artifact or an explicit evidence gap.
The retrospective names what did not improve and the next experiment.

exit_evidence: A runnable thin slice and production operating contracts
Two blind cases, one final mock, and a claim-to-artifact portfolio map
limits: The plan establishes foundations; it cannot substitute for repeated field ownership.
Synthetic artifacts must remain clearly labeled.
Independent operation and scoring require real reviewers when available.
